messages:
mike_support: FYI customer on Dedicated (cust-77) reports tool invocation failing in JSON mode. They send a function call but we return a 400 with \"invalid function args\". Happening since SDK v1.8.2 rollout.

mike_support: Error snippet from their server: ```
{\"error\":\"InvalidFunctionArguments\",\"message\":\"missing required key 'order_items' of type array\",\"code\":400}
```

mike_support: Customer says the payload is valid JSON and was working before. They attached a payload sample.

jamie_ml: can you paste the request body (redact keys)? suspect nested map got flattened by SDK change.

mike_support: pasted below (redacted): ```json
{
  \"model\":\"gpt-4-redwood\",
  \"json_mode\":true,
  \"function_call\":{
    \"name\":\"create_order\",
    \"arguments\":{
      \"order_id\":\"ORD-9012\",
      \"customer\":{
        \"id\":\"C-123\",
        \"email\":\"***@***.com\"
      },
      \"metadata\":null,
      \"order_items\":{
        \"item_1\":{
          \"sku\":\"SKU-1\",
          \"qty\":2
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

jamie_ml: aha — function schema expects order_items to be an array, not a map/object. SDK v1.8.2 introduced a coercion that converts small arrays to maps during compacting.

anya_oncall: any stack traces or runtime logs from our side? maybe the runtime's input validator logs the mismatch.

mike_support: from runtime logs for the request id provided: ```
2026-03-14T14:02:23Z WARN input_validator: function create_order args mismatch: field order_items expected array but got object at path function_call.arguments.order_items
2026-03-14T14:02:23Z ERROR api: respond 400 InvalidFunctionArguments request_id=req_0xabc123
```

jamie_ml: that's consistent. We should confirm whether the SDK or customer's serialization produced the map shape. Did they use the new compacting option?

mike_support: customer says they updated to SDK v1.8.2 and enabled \"compact_json=true\" per defaults. They say older platform version sent items as array and worked.

jamie_ml: temporary mitigation: tell them to set compact_json=false or send order_items explicitly as an array. We'll also add a server-side fallback to accept single-key object and coerce to array for one-off compatibility while we root cause.

anya_oncall: agree on fallback for Dedicated tenants for next 48h to reduce customer impact. Need a quick patch in input validation layer: if schema expects array and we receive an object with numeric or item_* keys, coerce to array. Put feature flag behind \"coerce_order_items_map\" and target rollout to Dedicated cluster only.

mike_support: customer impact: order creation requests failing => downstream billing errors. Customer asked for ETA.

jamie_ml: I can push the validation patch and flag this morning. Estimate 2-3hrs dev + 1hr canary. canary on one pod in us-west-2.

mike_support: told customer we'll enable a temporary workaround within 4 hours and follow up when fixed. They replied :relieved:.

jamie_ml: questions for engineering postmortem: why compact_json changed representation, and why our function schema validator is strict without an opt-in coercion policy.

anya_oncall: also check billing pipeline; failed requests might be double-billing in retry logic. I'll ask billing to review logs for req_0xabc123 and similar in the last 6h.

mike_support: repro steps I used locally (can reproduce):
1) curl to hosted endpoint with body above -> 400
2) change order_items to an array -> 200
3) run with SDK v1.7.9 -> array behavior preserved

mike_support: curl example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d @payload.json
```

jamie_ml: thanks. I'll open a GH issue linking SDK commit that introduced compacting and tag core-runtime.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: core-runtime input-validator patch (PR #4829) -> canary us-west-2.

anya_oncall: will monitor latency and error rates after canary. If errors drop, we can roll to other regions.

mike_support: customer asked for a postmortem and root cause. I'll draft a customer-facing note once we have timeline.

jamie_ml: root cause hypothesis: SDK compacting transforms small homogeneous arrays into keyed maps to reduce size; our function schema expects arrays and validation failed. action items:
- SDK: revert compacting for function_call.arguments arrays OR make compacting preserve array shape for known function args. (owner: sdk-team)
- Runtime: add lenient coercion for arrays-vs-maps for 48h (owner: jamie_ml)
- Billing: audit for double-billing on failed retried requests (owner: anya_oncall)

mike_support: tagging @eng-sre for monitoring and @billing for audit.

anya_oncall: note: add logs to indicate coerced requests so we can measure how many customers are affected.

mike_support: will follow up in 2h with customer and update this thread. :eyes:
